::: {#def-slr-deviation}
#### Deviation from the conditional mean

In a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian),
the **deviation** $\cdev_i$ of outcome $Y_i$
is its [deviation from its mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean),
taking the mean conditional on $X_i = x_i$:

$$\cdev_i \eqdef Y_i - \mean(x_i).$$
:::
